content: We need number of C=O groups in the molecule. But we have no SMILES given. Possibly the sample is implicit? We need to get IR spectra to see carbonyl stretch? Or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons? But we don't know molecule. Maybe the system expects to call ir_spectra to detect C=O. That would be cheaper than NMR? IR is good for carbonyl detection. So we should call ir_spectra.
